name: How do I create a budget for a custom kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I create a budget for a custom kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To create a budget for your custom kitchen renovation, start by identifying your priorities and must-have features. Research average costs for materials, appliances, and labor in your area. Allocate funds for various categories such as cabinetry, countertops, flooring, plumbing, electrical, and design fees. It's also wise to set aside an additional 10-15% of your total budget for unforeseen expenses. A clear budget helps guide design decisions and ensures financial planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Create a kitchen renovation budget by identifying priorities, researching costs for materials and labor, and allocating an additional 10-15% for unforeseen expenses.
